ValidationRule.description: This rule ensures that Notes field is populated whenever Concessions is marked as Waived or Reduced
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Price_Increase_Validation_Rules ) , ISBLANK( Notes__c ) , OR( ISPICKVAL( Pricing_Upgrade_Concessions__c , 'Waived' ) , ISPICKVAL( Pricing_Upgrade_Concessions__c , 'Reduced' ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add notes for Waived/Reduced Concessions.
